## Functional summary

This 215-amino-acid sequence is strongly identified as **large ribosomal subunit protein bL25**. It exactly matches a reviewed *Natranaerobius thermophilus* bL25 reference by sequence hash; the alignment covers 88.4% of the query (E-value 9.53 × 10⁻¹²⁸). Other bL25 homologs and two Pfam matches support the assignment.

bL25 is a **ribosomal structural protein** that binds **5S rRNA** and contributes to the ribosome’s central protuberance. The reference annotations place it in the cytosolic large ribosomal subunit and associate it with translation. These are reference-protein annotations, not results from an experiment on the supplied sequence.

**Sequence-derived properties:** 215 aa; predicted mass 24.27 kDa; theoretical pI 4.17; GRAVY −0.688; instability index 81.4. Pfam detects Ribosomal_L25p (residues 6–94) and Ribosomal_TL5_C (residues 103–184). The computed properties assume an unmodified, full-length protein; in particular, the instability index is a sequence-based estimate, not a measurement of protein stability.
